mapper.select: SELECT FROM pricing_scheme_template WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
SELECT FROM pricing_scheme_template WHERE scheme_id=#{schemeId} AND is_deleted=0 ORDER BY template_type
mapper.update: UPDATE pricing_scheme_template t SET t.template_code=#{templateCode},t.template_version=#{templateVersion},t.slot_bindings=#{slotBindings},t.row_version=t.row_version+1 WHERE t.id=#{id} AND t.row_version=#{rowVersion} AND t.is_deleted=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pricing_scheme s WHERE s.id=t.scheme_id AND s.status='DRAFT' AND s.is_deleted=0)

UPDATE pricing_scheme_template t SET t.is_deleted=1,t.row_version=t.row_version+1 WHERE t.id=#{id} AND t.row_version=#{rowVersion} AND t.is_deleted=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pricing_scheme s WHERE s.id=t.scheme_id AND s.status='DRAFT' AND s.is_deleted=0)
